title: Penjamin Cart Pen Ink Replacement (2 Pack)
description:
A replacement ink cartridge of the new Penjamin™ by Smyle™ Labs. To replace the Penjamin cart pen ink replacement, follow the steps below:
1. Twist and pull the bottom of the pen until the plastic tip of the pen comes off.
2. Insert and push the new replacement tip on your pen.
3. Check that your pen is working. Write and enjoy!
The Penjamin cart pen ink replacement makes it easy for you to continue using your Penjamin's ink freely without worrying about needing to get a whole new battery. People love the Penjamin cart pen ink replacement especially if you're writing a lot with your penjamin or doing art while using the aromatherapy features.
